notes: Registered 2026-07-28, after the [UNREGISTERED] gap was found: this repo had been a consumer since at least 2026-07-26 (inbound #177 came from here) without a manifest, so the source repo was blind to it. Fully adopted: all 19 specialists team-alpha ships (15 agents + 4 personas) have both a roster row and a lens, including 03-02 (Bianca), so the v2.9.0 persona check needs no ignore-list entry here. workflow-davekjohn ships no agents, hence the empty extensions list. UPDATED 2026-08-15 (#704): every statement above the line had gone stale and nothing here could see it. The record still named the plugin id 'specialists@claude-code-specialists', retired in the August 3 reorg; it said only that one plugin was enabled; and it said the consumer's .claude/settings.json had no extraKnownMarketplaces block. All three were false -- the live file (read from the GitHub API, repo pushed the same day) enables team-alpha AND workflow-davekjohn and does carry that block. THIS IS THE STRUCTURAL BLIND SPOT, not an oversight: the checkout is not on this machine, so check-connectors.ps1 reports [SKIP] for it and nothing in routine tooling ever compares the record against reality. Inventory is read from the GitHub API rather than a local checkout, and the check runs wherever this repo is cloned alongside it. CAUGHT UP 2026-08-27 (#978): the workflow plugin's id moved from 'workflow-davekjohn@' to 'contributing-davekjohn@' -- source issue #886, commit 8797f7a5, 2026-08-26 -- and this record held the retired name for a day after the consumer had migrated. Measured against their live .claude/settings.json (GitHub API): it enables team-alpha@ and contributing-davekjohn@. The sentences above keep the name they were WRITTEN with on purpose: they are dated measurements, and rewriting a measurement to match today's names is the defect #952 was made of. WHAT THE STALE ID COST, so the class is on record here too: check-connectors resolves each id against marketplace.json and reports one the marketplace no longer declares as an [INFO] -- correct, deliberate (August 9, 2026), and it SKIPS that plugin's whole block. So for a day this consumer's workflow plugin could not be reported as drifted whatever version they ran, exactly the blind spot xoxowildhearts.json documents one level up. The fix is the register catching up, not a new check: the comparison the report asks for already exists, and making it an error would re-open the four false alarms that made it an [INFO]. Also verified while here, because renaming the id makes the check read this block again after a day of skipping it: their contributing-davekjohn/releases/ tree has been migrated by hand (their PR #158) and the 39 + 2 files that inbound #955 measured at their repo root are gone -- releases/changelog/2.x now holds 40.
